author: justrucar
quote: Absolute garbage game. Heavily into ideological identity politics and feminist ideals.  Furthermore this is a boring game, missions are boring and some are relegated to helping your gf and that's okay for a Sims game but Rockstar lost their way with this game, the point of GTA is about crime and illegal underworld, this is why GTA peaked in GTA 5 and now this will be the start of the downfall. This game is not worth the money at all.
